title: Mars investigation at SRI just down the hall from the remote viewing program

tellings.quote: same place where they they We found out later that the remote viewing program was just down the hall from the headquarters of the Mars investigation.

plain: The Mars scientist John Brandenburg says that in the 1980s a study of possible signs of past life on Mars was run at SRI, the Stanford Research Institute in California. He says they 'found out later' that the government's remote viewing program, an effort to test whether people could describe distant places with the mind, 'was just down the hall' from the Mars study's headquarters, which he tells as a hint the two were linked.
